_readme: The slate. One entry per Loop — a Loop is the show, and it can own several scenes.
`scenes` holds SCENE ids, which are the folder names under loops/ and are exactly what
a note writes into its `loop` field. That indirection is the whole point: The Dripping
Pickle owns both factory-rt and cat-sequencer, so its tracker gathers notes from both.
The gallery and the feedback tracker BOTH read this file, so the grouping is stated once.
Adding a Loop: add an entry here, and a <section data-project="<id>"> to index.html.
